items.zh: 「应用」页现在可安装、升级、卸载，装了多处时可选择卸载哪一处
items.en: The Apps page installs, updates and uninstalls tools, and lets you pick which duplicate to remove

items.zh: 供应商图标可上传自己的图片，存进「我的图标」供其他供应商选用
items.en: Upload your own provider icon; it is kept in a My Icons library other providers can pick from

items.zh: 深链接可选接口格式、带自己的图标，并保留 Codex / Grok 配置
items.en: Deep links declare the API format, bring their own icon, and keep a Codex or Grok Build config

items.zh: 用量表新增首字耗时；面板闪烁、搜索框遮挡卡片等已修复
items.en: Usage tables show first-token time; fixed panel flicker and the search box covering cards
